news.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) officially questionable for Sunday
news.summary: The rookie will have a chance to make his return to the field after missing several games while on injured reserve. The team will make a determination about his availability closer to game time, and fantasy managers should temper expectations for him this week, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined against Cleveland.

news.title: Zay Flowers (toe) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: Baltimore's star wide receiver will be available to play on Sunday, despite still dealing with a minor toe injury of some kind. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week, although his ceiling will be considerably lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined for another week.

news.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) officially out for Week 6
news.summary: As expected, Monangai has officially been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons. He is reportedly considered week-to-week at this point, and fantasy managers should continue to expect D'Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson to serve as the team's top-two running backs in Monangai's continued absence.

news.title: Fred Johnson (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Johnson will be a full-go for Sunday against Carolina.

news.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) unavailable for Sunday
news.summary: Dulin is not going to be available to play on Sunday, which comes as no surprise, given that his hamstring injury left him sidelined at practice all week. His absence may lead to a bit more work for Keenan Allen against the Titans.

news.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
news.summary: Harris is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a hamstring injury right now and will have to miss some time while he recovers. Look for Quentin Johnston to be one of the primary beneficiaries of his absence.

news.title: Theo Johnson (neck) ruled out Sunday
news.summary: Johnson did not practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.summary: Barkley will remain sidelined after not practicing all week. Dameon Pierce is in line to lead the Eagles backfield.

news.title: Will Shipley (foot) placed on IR
news.summary: Shipley will miss at least the next four weeks for the Eagles.

news.title: David Sills V (hamstring) sidelined for Sunday
news.summary: Sills is not going to be available to play on Sunday, despite returning to practice in a full capacity this week. His next chance to play will come in Week 7, and his absence won't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

news.title: Michael Carter II (abdomen) ruled out Sunday
news.summary: Carter will be sidelined with an abdomen injury.

news.title: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) undergoes further testing
news.summary: Arroyo suffered the injury in Thursday's game against the Broncos. There should be an update on him by next week.

news.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) officially questionable for Sunday
news.summary: The rookie will have a chance to make his return to the field after missing several games while on injured reserve. The team will make a determination about his availability closer to game time, and fantasy managers should temper expectations for him this week, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined against Cleveland.

news.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) in non-contact jersey Friday in practice
news.summary: Moore returned to practice, but in limited fashion. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

news.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: Williams has been out for several games while tending to a hamstring injury, but he is officially questionable and will have a chance to make his return in Week 6 after being a full participant at practice all week. It looks more likely than not that he will play, which would be good news for Rome Odunze, Luther Burden III, and all of Chicago's fantasy options in a matchup against the Falcons.

news.title: Wydett Williams Jr. (concussion) ruled out Sunday
news.summary: Williams will be sidelined in concussion protocol.

news.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: Williams has been out for several games while tending to a hamstring injury, but he is officially questionable and will have a chance to make his return in Week 6 after being a full participant at practice all week. It looks more likely than not that he will play, which would be good news for Rome Odunze, Luther Burden III, and all of Chicago's fantasy options in a matchup against the Falcons.

news.title: Tyler Warren (groin) now questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Warren is a surprise addition to Indianapolis' injury report. He seems to have aggravated his groin late in the practice week and was limited on Friday, and it may very well leave him sidelined in Week 6. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next couple of days and should have a backup option ready in case the young tight end is ruled out.

news.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) questionable for Week 6
news.summary: Thompson is uncertain to play in Week 6 and is officially questionable with a quad issue. If he's cleared to play, he may see more work than usual with Tre' Harris (hamstring) set to be sidelined for the Chargers.

news.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) questionable for Sunday
news.summary: The Chargers are undecided on whether or not to activate Lambert-Smith for Week 6, so he carries a questionable tag heading into the weekend. He won't be very involved even if fully cleared to play against the Chiefs on Sunday, however.

news.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: Brown was able to make his return to practice in a limited fashion this week, and he now carries a questionable tag heading into the weekend. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to all updates about his health over the next couple of days, as he will be an obvious player to start if active without restrictions, but that will be complicated if he is on a snap count or sidelined altogether this week.

news.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Henderson suffered a high-ankle sprain last week, but he may not have to miss any time because of it, as he is officially considered questionable to play in Week 6. Fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him even if he's active, however, and Rhamondre Stevenson will be a quality starting option if the young running back is ruled out against the Jets.

news.title: Eli Stowers (quad) listed questionable Sunday
news.summary: Stowers remains off the fantasy radar if he makes his return.

news.title: Grant Calcaterra (back) listed questionable Sunday
news.summary: Calcaterra logged a full practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.title: DK Metcalf (illness) now questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: Metcalf is a new addition to Pittsburgh's injury report, being listed with an illness that left him sidelined at practice on Friday. He's now considered questionable to play heading into the weekend, and although it seems more likely than not that he will suit up, fantasy managers should still keep close tabs on all updates about his health over the next couple of days.

news.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) officially questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Dowdle may be available to make his return to the lineup on Sunday after logging two full practices to end the week, but he is still questionable, so that is uncertain at this point. His return would mean a but less work for Jaylen Warren moving forward, although Dowdle himself would be unlikely to have standalone value.

news.title: Sean Tucker (quad) questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Tucker will have a chance to play on Sunday, though he's still dealing with a quad injury and may very well be sidelined as a result. Fantasy managers should expect Kenny Gainwell to see a bit more work if that's the case.

news.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Spears is uncertain to play on Sunday. He is managing a nagging knee issue of some kind right now, but he was able to log a full practice on Friday still, which is a good sign that he will play through it. He will be worth keeping an eye on in this matchup if active, as he saw high involvement in the team's passing game last week.

news.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
news.summary: Bateman is going to be good to go for Sunday's game, despite missing practice on Thursday due to a shoulder issue. He should be a full go but doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option in this matchup against the Browns.

news.title: Zay Flowers (toe) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: Baltimore's star wide receiver will be available to play on Sunday, despite still dealing with a minor toe injury of some kind. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week, although his ceiling will be considerably lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined for another week.

news.title: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.

news.title: Tylan Wallace (knee) available to play Sunday
news.summary: Wallace will be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed with a knee injury at practice earlier in the week. He is unlikely to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

news.title: Josh Jacobs to be removed from Commissioner Exempt list Monday
news.summary: Schefter notes the investigation will remain open for the NFL so it "reserves the right to add further discipline if and when warranted." For now, Jacobs will be eligible to return in Week 7. He'll likely be eased back by the Packers.

news.title: Josh Downs (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: Downs will be available to play on Sunday, despite popping up on Indianapolis' injury report earlier in the week with a hamstring issue. Look for him to see a large portion of Indianapolis' passing work against the Titans on Sunday, especially if Tyler Warren (groin) is ruled out.

news.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) unavailable for Sunday
news.summary: Dulin is not going to be available to play on Sunday, which comes as no surprise, given that his hamstring injury left him sidelined at practice all week. His absence may lead to a bit more work for Keenan Allen against the Titans.

news.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: McConkey wasn't able to play much last week due to his foot injury, but he seems to be mostly over it at this point, as he is off of the injury report and good to go heading into the weekend. He will almost certainly be Los Angeles' top target in this game, but it's hard to trust starting him at this point with how bad Los Angeles' offense has looked through the first five games of the season.

news.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) set to play Sunday
news.summary: Valdes-Scantling is now off of the injury report after being limited at practice earlier in the week with a rib issue. He will play in Week 6 but doesn't project to make a big impact for the Chargers for the foreseeable future.

news.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) off injury report for Sunday
news.summary: Johnston was dealing with a chest injury at practice throughout the week, but it seems to be nothing more than a minor issue, as he is off of the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will play on Sunday and should see more work than usual with Tre' Harris (hamstring) set to be sidelined for the Chargers.

news.title: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Parkinson closed the week with a full practice on Friday.

news.title: Davis Allen (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Allen remains off the fantasy radar.

news.title: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

news.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Smith was able to end the week with a full practice on Friday. He'll be a WR2 play with Tanner McKee behind center for the Eagles.

news.title: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Wicks returned to a full practice on Friday after he missed practice on Thursday.

news.title: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.summary: A hamstring injury left Martin-Robinson limited at practice earlier in the week, but it's no longer an issue for him and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future with how bad Tennessee's offense is playing, however.

news.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) aiming for Week 5 return
news.summary: Jefferson has already been ruled out for Week 4, but the Vikings are planning to try to get him back on the field for Week 5's matchup with the Saints. Jefferson is still rehabbing his injured ankle this weekend and hopes to return to the practice field next week.

news.title: Kenyon Sadiq (back) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: The rookie had a breakout performance in Week 3, but his momentum may be halted by an injury, as he is now questionable to play ahead of Sunday's game against the Bears. If he's ruled out, look for veteran Jeremy Ruckert to serve as the team's TE1 with Mason Taylor (thumb) already ruled out for the Jets.

news.title: Jeremy Ruckert (thumb) will play Sunday
news.summary: The veteran is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite being limited at practice earlier in the week due to a thumb issue. He will see more work than usual with Mason Taylor (thumb) out and Kenyon Sadiq (back) questionable for this matchup against the Bears.

news.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) set to play Sunday
news.summary: Fitzpatrick is going to be available to make his return on Sunday after missing some time due to a groin issue. His presence should offer a nice boost to New York's secondary moving forward.

news.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) won't play Sunday
news.summary: As expected, Goedert is going to be sidelined for another game in Week 4 as he continues to recover from a knee issue. Devonta Smith (hamstring) is also going to be sidelined, so the Eagles will need to look to Dontayvion Wicks and rookie Makai Lemon to step up in this matchup against Los Angeles.

news.title: Chris Moore (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Moore is uncertain to play on Sunday as he continues to manage an ankle issue of some kind. Zay Flowers (hamstring) is also questionable to play, so Baltimore's offense will be much weaker if both of those guys are unable to suit up against the Titans.

news.title: Ray Davis (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
news.summary: Davis remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: The rookie is uncertain to play on Sunday. He missed last week's game due to a thigh injury, but he is officially questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. If he does, look for Hunter Henry to see less work as a result.

news.title: D'Andre Swift (knee) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: Swift was held out of Chicago's practice on Thursday, but he returned to practice as a full participant on Friday and carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He should be fully good to go for Sunday's game and should be a safe fantasy option against the Jets, though his fantasy upside will likely be limited with Caleb Williams (hamstring) out for another game.

news.title: Tyson Bagent expected to start in Week 4 for Bears
news.summary: It is a bit surprising following a big performance for Case Keenum last week. Bagent took the majority of first-team reps this week. The announcement should be made official this weekend.

news.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Dobbins will remain a touchdown dependent low-end RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.summary: Mims remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.title: Mo Alie-Cox (illness) cleared to play Sunday
news.summary: The Colts will have their veteran tight end on Sunday, as Alie-Cox has been cleared to play after missing two practices early in the week due to an illness. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however.

news.title: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday
news.summary: The veteran is going to be good to go on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report throughout the week due to an ankle issue. He will continue to play second fiddle behind Omarion Hampton on this offense, although his exact snap share remains worth keeping an eye on this week.

news.title: Puka Nacua (groin) will play Sunday
news.summary: Barshop notes that "the Rams are still working through how they will navigate Nacua's snap count." It will still be tough to sit him in fantasy lineups.

news.title: Chris Bell (knee) will play Sunday
news.summary: The rookie is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Miami's injury report due to a knee issue of some kind. He will be primed for a lot of work with Caleb Douglas (ankle) already ruled out ahead of Week 4's matchup against the Vikings.

news.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) officially good to go for Sunday
news.summary: As expected, Wright is off of Miami's injury report heading into the weekend and should be a full go against the Vikings on Sunday. Week 4 will be very telling on how the backfield reps will be split between him and Ollie Gordon II in the absence of De'Von Achane (knee), so fantasy managers should keep tabs on what his workload looks like this week.

news.title: Jeremy Ruckert (thumb) will play Sunday
news.summary: The veteran is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite being limited at practice earlier in the week due to a thumb issue. He will see more work than usual with Mason Taylor (thumb) out and Kenyon Sadiq (back) questionable for this matchup against the Bears.

news.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) cleared to play Sunday
news.summary: Nwangwu is set to make his season debut on Sunday after missing the first three games of the season due to a lingering back issue. He is expected to be relegated mostly to special teams, however, so he isn't likely to have much of an impact on New York's offense moving forward.

news.title: Ryan Miller (hip/back) officially questionable for Sunday
news.summary: Miller is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is likely considered day-to-day as a result. If he's cleared to play, he will see more work than usual with Caleb Douglas (ankle) set to be sidelined against the Chiefs.

news.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) questionable to play Sunday
news.summary: Warren is still not 100% healthy at this point and officially carries a questionable tag heading into the weekend due to the shoulder injury that he's dealing with. He will likely be a great fantasy option this week if he's cleared to play without any major restrictions, however, as the team has already ruled out Rico Dowdle (toe) for this divisional matchup.

news.title: Cairo Santos (thigh) misses practice Friday
news.summary: Santos might be out this week, as he hasn't participated at either of Chicago's practices to start the week. It remains to be seen who they would choose to be their spot starter if the veteran is unable to play against Philadelphia.

news.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.summary: Harvey is set to make his return to the field in Week 3 after being sidelined for one game due to a hamstring issue. He should see a full workload against the Rams this week, especially with rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) set to be sidelined in that matchup.

news.title: Jordan Whittington (quad) set to play Sunday
news.summary: Whittington will be good to go for Sunday night's game, which is good news for the Rams given that Puka Nacua (hip) is not expected to be available to play. He isn't worth starting in most fantasy leagues at this point, however, even if he's a quality contributor for the team in real life.

news.title: DeeJay Dallas (toe) will play Sunday
news.summary: Dallas is going to be available to play on Sunday, as his toe injury is not considered a substantial issue for him right now. Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) has also been cleared to play, however, which will render Dallas irrelevant from a fantasy perspective this week.

news.title: Cooper Kupp (back) available to play Sunday
news.summary: Kupp is going to play on Sunday. He was dealing with a back injury earlier in the week, but it's nothing serious at this point and won't affect his availability against the Commanders. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option in this matchup, however, even with Sam Darnold (glute) set to make his return for the Seahawks.

news.title: Sam Darnold (glute) good to go Sunday
news.summary: Darnold was able to practice all week. He winds up missing only two games (including Week 1 when he was injured in the first series). He'll look to keep keep the Seahawks offense rolling heading into Washington on Sunday.

news.title: Daniel Bellinger (illness) good to go for Sunday
news.summary: The veteran tight end will be available to play against his former team on Sunday, despite recently missing a practice due to an illness of some kind. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however, even though he's healthy.
